title: Was Javert Right to Be Suspicious? Marginal Treatment Effects with Duration Outcomes
title_zh: 贾维特的怀疑是对的吗？持续期结果下的边际处理效应
authors: Santiago Acerenza, Vitor Possebom, Pedro H. C. Sant’Anna
abstract: We identify the distributional and quantile marginal treatment effect functions when the outcome is right-censored. Our method requires a conditionally exogenous instrument and random censoring. We propose asymptotically consistent semi-parametric estimators and valid inferential procedures for the target functions . To illustrate, we evaluate the effect of alternative sentences (fines and community service vs. no punishment) on recidivism in Brazil. Our results highlight substantial treatment effect heterogeneity: we find that people whom most judges would punish take longer to recidivate, while people who would be punished only by strict judges recidivate at an earlier date than if they were not punished.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了当结果存在右删失时的分布和分位数边际处理效应函数。该方法要求工具变量条件外生且删失随机。我们提出了目标函数的渐近一致半参数估计量及有效推断程序。为进行说明，我们评估了巴西替代性刑罚（罚金与社区服务 vs. 无惩罚）对再犯率的影响。研究结果凸显了显著的处理效应异质性：多数法官倾向于施以惩罚的个体再犯间隔时间更长，而仅被严厉法官判处惩罚的个体，其再犯时间反而早于未受惩罚的情况。

title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置
abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工的大幅且持续的收入下降相关。通过将巴西雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息相关联，我发现负面效应主要集中在离职的目标企业员工身上，这既反映了短期内的岗位流失，也体现了长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位及年长员工受到的影响更为严重。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的重新配置成本，这反映了企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配效率低下以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工转而流向被认为生产率和就业价值较低的低薪企业。

title: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
title_zh: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：Elsevier API
abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior. Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a “sole owner” over particularly economically desirable altitudes.
abstract_zh: 全球太空经济继续快速增长，与轨道卫星和碎片有关的公共政策挑战不断显现，但将理论经济学框架与实际轨道使用联系起来的证据却出人意料地稀少。本文使用一个结合经济模型与太空环境物理模型的前沿综合评估模型，发现观测到的卫星轨道分布可以由卫星运营商利润最大化行为很好地解释。进一步结果表明，碰撞风险发挥了重要的威慑作用。最后，最大卫星星座 Starlink 的实际部署位置，与其在经济价值尤其高的轨道高度上表现为“单一所有者”的行为相一致。

title: Shadow Activity and Unemployment in a Depressed Labour Market
title_zh: 萧条劳动力市场中的影子活动与失业
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This Paper studies the border between shadow employment and unemployment. It argues that the two macroeconomic phenomena are two faces of the same coin: any policy aimed at reducing the former will increase the latter. Theoretically, it proposes and solves a matching model of the labour market, where shadow employment emerges in equilibrium as the endogenous response of firms and workers who felt overburdened by taxes and regulations. While the model we propose neatly rationalizes the labour market trade-off implied by ?shadow reducing policies?, it suggests that economies with low unemployment turnover should be characterized also by low turnover along the shadow margins. Since existing estimates of shadow employment are silent on labour market flows and on the relation between shadow activity and the main labour market aggregates, we perform original empirical work on the border between employment, unemployment and inactivity, and we find that Italian shadow employment has longer duration in regions with lower unemployment turnover. We also find support to the substantive assumptions of the model.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了影子就业与失业之间的边界。研究认为，这两种宏观经济现象是同一枚硬币的两面：任何旨在减少前者的政策都将导致后者的增加。在理论层面，本文提出并求解了一个劳动力市场的匹配模型，在该模型中，影子就业作为企业和工人因税收与监管负担过重而产生的内生反应，在均衡状态下出现。尽管我们提出的模型清晰地解释了“减少影子政策”所隐含的劳动力市场权衡关系，但它也表明，失业流动率较低的经济体，其影子就业边际的流动率也应较低。由于现有对影子就业的估算并未涉及劳动力市场流动以及影子活动与主要劳动力市场总量之间的关系，我们针对就业、失业与非经济活动之间的边界开展了原创性实证研究，并发现意大利影子就业在失业流动率较低的地区持续时间更长。此外，我们还找到了支持模型实质性假设的证据。
